text: ofttold-memory 是 DSH 网页端的个人记忆插件：它按标题从本地 Markdown 文件夹读取精选内容，并在会话开始时注入上下文。插件也会准备缺失的起始文件，提供记住事实或待办、勾选已完成任务和更新当前情绪的工具，并在上下文尾部提示日记状态。适合希望跨会话保留自定义笔记、索引和日常记录的 DSH 用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

ofttold-memory brings local Markdown notes into each DSH web session. It injects configured sections at the start, prepares missing starter files, and offers tools to save facts or tasks and complete tasks. It adds diary status to the context. No API key or external service is required.
想让自己整理的 Markdown 记忆在每次 DSH 会话开始时自动出现。
怎样把一份本地笔记里的指定标题带进聊天上下文？
我希望 DSH 跨会话记住常用事实和个人约定。
能不能让 DSH 帮我把待办记下来，并在完成后勾掉？
我想根据标题选择要注入的笔记段落，还能限制长度。
会话开始时提醒我今天的日记有没有写。
I want selected Markdown notes to appear in each new DSH session.
Can DSH keep my recurring facts and open tasks in a local memory folder?
ofttold-memory 按配置的文件与标题读取 Markdown 段落，并在会话第一步将内容作为上下文消息注入；默认尝试中英文常用记忆标题。
ofttold-memory 的 remember_note 工具把一行事实写入记忆锚点，或把未完成工作作为待办追加到 Markdown 文件。
ofttold-memory 的 complete_task 工具按待办文本勾选任务，任务仍留在文件中作为记录，并从未完成统计中移除。
ofttold-memory 在注入上下文末尾加入当日日记提醒，并可报告日记检查发现的摘要或条目问题。

ofttold-memory README · ofttold-memory · 拾光：---

每天它往里写：今天你们做了什么、它怎么看、它自己在哪一步老出错。下次开口之前，它先把本子翻一遍——**所以它记得的不只是你说过什么，还有它自己想过的。**

你也可以告诉它「我希望你是什么样的人」。这句话会被写进本子里，**不用每次重新嘱咐**。

装完第一天，本子是空的。这不是坏了——它得先跟你过几天日子。

慢慢你会养出自己那一只大肥鱼——**和别人的不太一样。**

---

ofttold-memory README · 装上之后，第几天会有什么变化：| | 你会看到什么 |
|---|---|
| 第 1 天 | 本子是空的。它开始往里写，你可能只会在回答的边角看到它提一句「今天还没写」。 |
| 第 3 天 | 它开始接得上上次的事——「你上次说的那个……」——而且那是它自己记下的版本，不是你把话重复一遍。 |
| 第 10 天 | 它开始有自己的一套说法：对你的判断、它老在哪一步出错、它今天什么情绪。你可以直接问它「你记的我什么」。 |
| 一个月后 | 本子有几百行，但它只挑八条摆在眼前——**写满不会让它变慢**。 |

这个延迟是设计的一部分。**它不是一个装完就生效的东西，是一个每天长一点的东西。**

---
section: 装上之后，第几天会有什么变化

text:
ofttold-memory README · 它做什么，不做什么：**会做的**都是「每次都应该发生、但靠自觉一定漏」的那类：

- 把清单摆到眼前（每会话一次）
- 清单满了，按 `exp(-t / 2^n)` 算谁该沉底
- 没写日期的条目，就地补上「从哪天起算」
- 文件夹缺东西时补上（缺哪个补哪个），提醒今天日记没写，读不到时说明试过什么
- 今天那篇日记的**体检**：缺 `情绪：` 行、标签不在词表里、摘要落后于正文（节数只在你自己设了上限时才管）

**不做的**恰好是需要判断的那一半：

- **不替你决定记什么。** 清单里写什么、允许它沉谁，都是写的人的事——插件只负责算。
- **不替你判断现在是什么情绪。** 值由写的人定；但**写这一下**插件管——`remember_emotion` 工具会校验词表、带上时间戳，词不在表里就拒绝并列出有哪些。
- **不自动写日记。** 没写就提醒一句，不会替你补。

分界线是「失败了看不看得见」：**看不见的必须交给代码，看得见的留给写的人。** 上限、权重、词表的推导在 **[设计说明](docs/design.md)**。

---

ofttold-memory README · 它花多少 token：> **一个会话里注入一次，但那一段一直留在上下文里，每轮都会重新发一遍**（按缓存命中的价）。所以它按「轮」计，不按「次」计。

实测（反复出现的那 8 条 + 2 条没做完的待办）：**945 字符 ≈ 700 token**。

| 一天多少轮 | 注入部分的 token | 缓存命中（0.02 元/百万） | 未命中（1 元/百万） |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 3.5 万 | 0.0007 元 | 0.035 元 |
| 200 | 14 万 | 0.0028 元 | 0.14 元 |

**一天到不了一分钱。** 没命中缓存也就几毛。

**真正花钱的是对话本身，不是这个插件。** 上下文越长，每一轮都要把前面重发一遍——账单跟着长度走，不跟着这里那 700 token 走。

ofttold-memory README · 它花多少 token：拿我们自己举例（2026-11-03 → 11-06，四天，1108 步，`deepseek-v4.1-flash`，按当时官网价）：输入 **2.36 亿 token**（其中 2.02 亿是缓存命中）、输出 **82 万**，**约 40–80 元**。那是「整天泡着聊」的强度，不是人均。

公式（价格随时会变，自己代）：**每轮 ≈ 上下文 tokens × 输入单价 + 输出 tokens × 输出单价**，插件那 700 token 就加在上下文里。

想知道自己的账：日志里存着每次调用的 `inputTokens` / `cacheReadTokens` / `outputTokens`，加一遍就有。

---

ofttold-memory README · 快速开始：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ofttold-memory@latest
```

**这就是全部安装步骤。** 装的是 npm 上的预构建产物，没有构建步骤，不需要额外授权；想跟仓库最新代码走，把包名换成 `github:IcyDate/ofttold-memory` 即可。 第一次运行会在**当前工作区里**创建 `.ofttold/`，并铺一份五文件骨架：`memory.md`（注入源）、`index.md`（日记索引）、`relationship.md`（我是谁 + 情绪缓存区）、`detours.md`（我总在哪一步拐错）、`diary/`（一天一个文件）。**全是空壳加注释，一条记忆都不预填**——写什么只能由你决定。把 `memoryDir` 指向你已有的文件夹——日记、索引、规则文件都算——插件**只补缺的那几个文件，已有文件一个字都不动**：它会补上 `relationship.md`（情绪词表与缓存区住在那里）和 `diary/`（块尾那句提醒靠它），否则写的那一半会缺一块。

ofttold-memory README · 快速开始：然后打开 **设置 → 拾光** 用鼠标调整，或者直接改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

---

ofttold-memory README · 第一条：`pnpm` 不是内部或外部命令：`dsh plugin` 只是把参数转发给 **pnpm**，而**装 dsh 不会顺带装 pnpm**。全新机器上第一条命令就会停在这儿：

```
'pnpm' 不是内部或外部命令，也不是可运行的程序或批处理文件。
```

先装它：

```powershell
npm install -g pnpm
pnpm --version
```

`pnpm --version` 打出版本号才算通了。

section: 第一条：`pnpm` 不是内部或外部命令

text:
ofttold-memory README · 第二条：`.ps1` 被执行策略拦下：真实测出来的，不是猜的。**在全新 Windows 上第一次跑 `dsh` 命令，十个里有九个会撞这一条**：

```
dsh : 无法加载文件 C:\Users\<你>\AppData\Roaming\npm\dsh.ps1，因为在此系统上禁止运行脚本。
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : UnauthorizedAccess
```

**这不是插件坏，是 Windows 客户端 PowerShell 默认的执行策略（`Restricted`）不允许运行任何 `.ps1` 脚本**，而 npm 给 `dsh` 生成的启动器正好是一个 `.ps1`。

**别去改执行策略**（那是整台机器的持久设置）。npm 在 Windows 上同时生成了 `dsh.cmd`，`.cmd` 不受执行策略管：

```powershell

section: 或者直接开一个 cmd 窗口（不是 PowerShell）

text:
ofttold-memory README · 第三条：镜像比包慢：如果报

```
ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION  No matching version found for ofttold-memory@0.1.x
while fetching it from https://registry.npmmirror.com/
```

**是国内的 npmmirror 还没同步到最新版本**，不是包没发出去。等十几分钟重试，或者临时指定官方源：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add ofttold-memory@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

ofttold-memory README · 第四条：如果你在让 AI 代你装：`dsh` 的 agent 有文件沙箱，而插件**必须装进 `~\.dsh\profiles\`**——那个位置在沙箱外，agent 会报

```
EPERM: operation not permitted, open 'C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json.lock'
```

**这条命令请自己在终端里敲。** 装完之后插件运行时写记忆是 DSH 自己的进程，不受那个沙箱限制。

text: ofttold-memory README · 文件长什么样：```markdown

ofttold-memory README · 常被提起：> 建议上限 8 条。满了按权重沉底——挤掉这个动作本身就是一次排序，
> 比「想起就随手加一条」可靠。
>
> **这一节叫「常被提起」，因为里面装的就该是那种事**：几个月后你还会想起来的、
> 换了场景也说得通的那几条。一个只出现过一次的事故不算——它是日记的事。

- **项目在哪** → `~/work/my-project`｜省掉每次都要问
- **什么不能动** → 不要改 `config/prod.yml`
ofttold-memory README · 我是谁：- （怎么称呼我、说话习惯、脾气、在意什么）

ofttold-memory README · 硬约定：- （不写就会干错活的：谁归谁管、哪些命令不能跑）
```

**判断什么该进来，只有一个标准：** 不看见它会不会干错活？不是「重要」，不是「经常提到」，而是**「不看见就会出错」**。按这个标准写，八条足够；按「重要」写，永远不够。

ofttold-memory README · 清单满了不会越写越长：写满 8 条之后，插件**按权重挑谁沉底**，而不是靠谁记得去删一条：常被翻出来的留下，久没被提过的沉下去。**沉底不是删除**——还在文件里，日记里再提一次就浮回来。

公式和推导在 **[设计说明 § 沉底机制](docs/design.md#沉底机制libanchorsjs)**。
section: 清单满了不会越写越长

text:
ofttold-memory README · 一天的摘要在顶部：一天的文件开头是 `## 今天（17:40 更新）`——两三句：这天是什么日子、什么感觉，**吐槽就写这儿**。细节在下面，想翻再翻。

摘要是**随写随新**的：写一节的同时顺手改它，不是晚上补。插件会把 `（HH:mm 更新）` 和正文最后一个 `## HH:mm` 比一比，**正文跑过摘要就点名**——所以「加班到 21:00 又写了一节」这件事不会让摘要悄悄过期。

`summaryFrom`（默认 `17:30`）之前不催摘要：上午写的那半截本来还不是一天。

ofttold-memory README · 日记体检：同一行还管三件事，都是**只报不改**：

| 看到什么 | 会说什么 |
|---|---|
| 一天超过 `diarySections` 节（**默认关掉**，设了数才检查） | `9 sections, over the 8-per-day bar` |
| 有节没写 `情绪：` 行 | `2 without an \`情绪：\` line` |
| 标签的词不在词表里 | `烦躁 not in the vocabulary` |
| 用了标签但没有词表节 | `tags used, but relationship.md has no \`情绪词表\` section` |
| 过了 `summaryFrom` 还没有摘要 | `no \`## 今天\` summary at the top` |
| 摘要落后于正文 | `summary stopped at 17:40, body runs to 21:10` |

整句长这样：`Diary check — 9 sections, over the 8-per-day bar; …`

ofttold-memory README · 日记体检：**「标签必须来自词表」不是口味，是结构**：值只能取词表里的词，所以表外的标签永远匹配不上——不报错，只是那天从此不能被情绪找到。

**只报不改**：整理必然压缩，而压缩会删掉权重赖以计算的「被想起」的证据。推导在 **[设计说明 § 一条结构性的规矩](docs/design.md#一条结构性的规矩)**。

ofttold-memory README · 记一个情绪：`relationship.md` 里的 `**现在**` 那一行是**活值**：只放此刻的情绪，不放原因。改它用工具，不靠记格式：

```
remember_emotion(word: "定")
→ 现在：`定`（2026-10-30 11:20 更新）（原来是 `心虚`）
```

- 词必须在同一份文件的 `## 情绪词表` 节里，否则**拒绝**并列出可用的词
- 词表节不存在时也**拒绝**——不在这里造一份默认词表，那就又多一份会漂的拷贝
- 只改反引号里的词和时间戳，那一行的标点、前后文字一个字节不动

**为什么是工具不是文档**：这一行一天要改好几次，而两种错法都不出声——词不在表里，之后和日记标签永远对不上；时间戳忘了写，缓存看着像新的。

ofttold-memory README · 让它记住一件事：「我记下了」这句话，如果没有落到文件里，**它和没记是一样的**——而且看不出来。

所以这件事做成了一个工具：

```
remember_note(text: "主人喜欢一条溪穿街的古镇，黄龙溪那种", title: "主人喜欢古镇")
→ added to memory.md · 常被提起: - **主人喜欢古镇** → 主人喜欢一条溪穿街的古镇，黄龙溪那种
```

`kind` 有两种：

| 值 | 写到哪 | 用来记什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor`（默认） | `memory.md` 的 `常被提起` | **以后还该成立的事**——偏好、约定、纠正过的认知 |
| `task` | `memory.md` 的 `待办`（第一次用时建） | **还欠着的活** |

任务是能结算的：

```markdown
- [ ] 2026-11-02 起 ｜ 2026-11-05 到期 ｜ 修上游白名单
- [x] 2026-11-01 起 ｜ 等 #15 合并（2026-11-03 完成）
```

ofttold-memory README · 让它记住一件事：`complete_task` 把框勾上、补一个完成日。**勾掉不是删掉**——已完成的留在文件里当证据，只是不再计数。块尾会报「还有几条、最久那条挂了几天」，**挂了多久比有几条有用**：条数只让你知道有一堆，天数才告诉你该不该现在动手。

**写了到期日的会到点说话**：那天块尾点名 `- 1 task due now: 修上游白名单（今天到期）`，过了就说「逾期 N 天」。没写到期日的永远只会「变老」——`the oldest open 5 days` 不是「今天该做」。

**同一天开第二个会话时，它会说今天那一篇不是这个会话写的。** 块尾不只是问「今天有没有日记」——那样第二个会话看到别的会话写的那篇就整段沉默。现在它比对文件修改时间和会话创建时间，写在本会话开始之前就会说 `today's entry was last written at 10:26, before this session started`。

ofttold-memory README · 让它记住一件事：**`relationship.md` 每天第一次开口前会被点一次名。** 这份文件一个字都不进注入块（它只在被翻的时候才在场），所以块尾会说 `- \`relationship.md\` has not been opened today`，直到 AI 真的用文件工具打开过它——那一天就不再提。**它测的是「工具读过没有」，用 shell `cat` 读到的不算**，所以这是个偏保守的信号：宁可多问一次，不假设已经看过。

**挂太久的会换一种语气**：超过 `taskStaleDays`（默认 30 天）还没做的，不再计入条数，而是点名问你「还要不要」。一条待办两个月里每会话都被提一次，它就成了背景噪音——**问「要不要删」是真问题，催「怎么还没做」不是。**

**为什么是工具，不是一份措辞清单**：说法太多——记下了、记住了、放心上了、你记着——按词匹配永远漏一个。按**动作**就不会：调用了有痕迹，没调用就是没发生。

`task` 写进去之后，块尾会报「还有几条没做」——**写下来不等于会去读**，所以它得自己露面。

ofttold-memory README · 块尾那一行：如果记忆文件夹里有 `diary/`，注入的末尾会多一行状态：

```
- no diary entry for 2026-10-30 yet (`diary/2026-10-30.md`)
```

**它刻意写成一行状态，不是一句指令**——没有「快写」，也不点 skill 的名字。因为同一个块尾还装着上面的体检报告，那是真的会坏事的消息；提醒要是也一副催的口气，**两行都会被跳过**。它只花一次 `stat`，作用是让「今天写不写」不靠想起来的。

**多久写一次由 `diaryCadence` 决定**：`daily`（默认）每天催；`weekly` 只在最近 7 天一个字都没写时才开口；`off` 永不提醒。两种情况下它都会闭嘴：**没有 `diary/` 目录**（这说明这个文件夹不走日记这套），或者 **cadence 是 `off`**（那是想停写又不想删历史）。

ofttold-memory README · 块尾那一行：**还有一种状态，前两句都看不见它**：今天的文件在、也确实是这个会话写的，然后几个小时没再动过。这段时间里每一条检查都是绿的——文件确实存在——可那几个小时发生的事一件都没进去。`diaryStaleHours`（默认 `2`）到点就让块尾报出**最后写入的时刻和间隔**：`- today's entry was last written at 11:36, more than 2h ago`。它只报时刻，不说该不该写，也不逐分钟往上跳——读起来是事实，不是一只催你的钟。`0` 关掉。

---

ofttold-memory README · 真正要调的只有这几个：| 配置项 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryDir` | `.ofttold`（工作区里） | 记忆文件夹。**默认在会话工作区里面**——助手写日记用的是它自己的文件工具，那些在默认策略下只能写工作区。第一次运行自动补齐缺失的文件。 |
| `sections` | 见下 | 取哪几节。不配时：那一节取 `Oft-told` / `常被提起` 里**先出现的那一个**，另加 `我是谁`、`硬约定`（有就读）。 |
| `maxChars` | `600` | 每节字符上限。600 字符约 400 token。 |
| `anchorCap` | `8` | 一节的粗体列表最多留几条，超出的沉底但不删。`0` 关掉。 |
| `summaryFrom` | `"17:30"` | 从几点开始要求顶部有 `## 今天` 摘要。 |
| `diaryCadence` | `"daily"` | 多久写一次：`daily` / `weekly`（最近 7 天有写过就不催）/ `off`（永不提醒）。 |
| `diaryStaleHours` | `2` | 今天这篇停笔多少小时后，块尾报出最后写入的时刻。只报事实，不催。`0` 关掉。 |
| `diarySections` | `0` | 一天最多几节。默认 `0`＝不数——**节数说明不了是不是流水账**。 |
| `diaryCheck` | `true` | 日记体检开关。 |
| `detourChars` | `3000` | 弯路文件最大多少字。它只该装**重复犯的那几种错**，超了就已经是第二本日记。`0` 关掉。 |
| `taskStaleDays` | `30` | 待办挂多少天算太久。超过就不算进「有几条」，改口问「还要不要」。`0` 关掉。 |

text:
ofttold-memory README · 它怎么做到的：> 本子就是几个 markdown 文件，在你自己的电脑上。每个会话开头读一次、注入一次，之后一直留在上下文里（不是每轮重新读，但仍会随历史一起重发——开销见上面「它花多少 token」）。 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[你的本子
memory.md] -->|按小节名取| B[读取 + 截断] B --> C[注入一次
作为用户消息] C --> D[会话上下文] 一次读取，一次注入。没有索引、没有向量、没有数据库，也没有第二次检索。想调的东西只有几个，都写在 [配置说明](docs/config.md)。 ---

ofttold-memory README · 什么都没注入时：文件不存在、小节名改了，都不会抛错。**一节都没读到时，注入块会照实说它试过什么：**

```
Could not load any section. Tried: index.md → 常被提起 (heading_not_found)
```

`heading_not_found` 只差一个字也算没找到（`常被提起` 匹配不上 `常被提起（手动维护）`）。空文件夹则是另一种说法：**这是第一天，不是坏了。**

完整记录仍然在：

```sh
cat ~/.dsh/ofttold-memory/diagnostics.json
```

每一次注入决策都在里面：文件夹、读到几节、哪几节失败以及为什么。**它从不记录你笔记的正文**，所以可以直接贴进 issue。设置页里有「复制问题摘要」按钮，取的是同一份信息。

ofttold-memory README · 什么都没注入时：| `event` | 意思 |
|---|---|
| `injected` | 成功。`loaded` 是节数，`chars` 是注入块大小。 |
| `nothing-loaded` | 文件夹找到了，但没有配置的小节名对上——通常是改了标题。读到这一条时，会话里也会出现一段说明，写明找过哪个文件、哪个标题。 |
| `tail` | 块尾那句：`nudged`＝提醒了今天没写，`checked`＝体检说了话，`issue` 是它说了什么。 |

文件不存在，说明插件根本没走到决策那一步，问题在安装而不在内容。

---

ofttold-memory README · 它碰什么，不碰什么：给做供应链审查的人看的——这个插件会读写文件，这一点没法「声明成不碰」，所以把它做什么写清楚：

| | |
|---|---|
| **读** | `memoryDir` 里你指定的那几个 `##` 小节；`diary/` 下今天的文件；`relationship.md` 的词表；`detours.md` 的字数 |
| **写** | 只在 `memoryDir` 内：补缺失的骨架文件、给没日期的条目补起算日、追加/勾选 `memory.md` 的待办、改 `relationship.md` 的那一行「现在」、把旧文件名改过来 |
| **不写** | `memoryDir` 之外一处都不写。不碰 `~/.dsh`、不碰工作区、不碰会话数据 |
| **网络** | 零。没有任何出站请求 |
| **子进程** | 零。不 exec、不 spawn、不 shell |
| **凭据** | 零。不读环境变量里的任何密钥、不读 keychain |

ofttold-memory README · 它碰什么，不碰什么：**运行期依赖：零。** `package.json` 里没有 `dependencies`——`@deepseek-ai/*` 全部走 `peerDependencies`（由宿主提供），用到的 `schemastery` 也来自宿主。

**失败边界**：任何一次读写失败都不抛到宿主，只在注入块末尾用一句话说明（「试过哪里、为什么没读到」）；文件夹不存在时补骨架，路径不可写时保持沉默而不反复重试。

---

ofttold-memory README · 名字从哪来：这个插件是从一个人和一个 AI 之间真实跑通的一套办法里长出来的，名字也是那套办法给的。

**拾光** —— 也是**时光**的谐音。意思落在「拾」这个字上：把散落的东西，一件一件捡回来。

那套办法是：一个日记文件夹、一份索引（顶上列着几条常被提起的事）、还有一条写在 AI 指令最前面的要求——*每次开工先读这两个文件*。这条要求一直管用，直到它不再管用；而它失效的位置，恰恰是它本该守住的地方——会话开头，新消息最要紧的那一刻。

于是要求换成了机制。**那份清单从「模型得记得去读的东西」变成了「它不可能错过的上下文」。** 整个改动就这一句话。

---

ofttold-memory README · 为什么不用写进 `AGENTS.md`？：因为一条指令和一条注入的消息，付钱的方式不一样。

| | 每轮都在吗 | 每轮付多少 | 会不会被跳过 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` 里一条规矩 | 在 | 整条规矩的长度 | 会——而且是不声不响地 |
| 这个插件 | 在 | 约 700 token，基本都命中缓存 | 不会——它是这一轮对话的一部分 |

**两边每轮都跟着请求走，也都走缓存。** 差别只有两样：**长度**，和**它会不会被当成背景跳过**。实测一次注入约 **945 字符 ≈ 700 token**（8 条的时候），而一条规矩常常比它长得多。**只要规矩比注入块长，规矩就输**，而它几乎立刻就输。

**所以：内容放进记忆文件，别把指令塞进 `AGENTS.md`。**

ofttold-memory README · ofttold-memory · 拾光：---

Every day something goes in: what you did together, what it made of it, where it keeps
getting a step wrong. Before it speaks, it opens the notebook and reads back through it —
**so what it remembers is not only what you said, but what it thought about what you said.**

You can also tell it what kind of assistant you want it to be. That goes in the notebook
too, **so you are not repeating yourself every time**.

ofttold-memory README · ofttold-memory · 拾光：On the first day the notebook is empty. That is not a fault — it has to live through a few
days with you first.

Over time you grow your own 大肥鱼 — **not quite the same one as anybody else's.**

---

ofttold-memory README · What changes, and when：| | What you will see |
|---|---|
| Day 1 | The notebook is empty. It starts writing; the most you will notice is a line at the end of a reply saying today is unwritten. |
| Day 3 | It starts picking up where you left off — "the thing you mentioned last time" — and that is *its own* record of it, not you saying it again. |
| Day 10 | It has its own way of putting things: what it makes of you, where it keeps going wrong, how it feels today. Ask it "what do you have on me" and it can answer. |
| A month in | A few hundred lines, but only eight are put in front of it — **filling up does not slow it down.** |

ofttold-memory README · What changes, and when：The delay is the design. **This is not something that takes effect when it is installed; it is something that grows by a day at a time.**

---

ofttold-memory README · What it does, and what it leaves alone：**It does** the things that should happen every time and reliably get skipped:

- puts the list in front of the model, once per session
- when the list is full, computes which line sinks: `exp(-t / 2^n)`
- stamps a start date on lines that have no date of their own
- fills in missing files, names an unwritten day, says what it tried when nothing loads
- checks today's entry: sections past the cap, sections with no `情绪：` line, a tag outside
  the vocabulary, a summary the body has run past
section: What it does, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · What it does, and what it leaves alone：- **It does not decide what is worth remembering.** What goes on the list, and whether a
  sinking line deserves rescuing, is the writer's call. The plugin only does the arithmetic.
- **It does not decide what you feel.** The value is the writer's call; writing it is the
  plugin's — `remember_emotion` checks the vocabulary, stamps the time, and refuses a word
  that is not on the list.
- **It does not write the diary.** It names an unwritten day and stops there.
section: What it does, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · What it does, and what it leaves alone：The line between the two is **"would the failure be visible?"** — invisible failures go to
code, visible ones stay with the writer. Reasoning is in
**[Design notes](docs/design.en.md)**.

---
section: What it does, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · What it costs in tokens：> **Injected once per session — but it stays in the context and is re-sent every turn** (at the cache-hit price). So it costs per *turn*, not per *session*.

Measured with the 8 lines that keep coming back plus 2 open tasks: **945 characters ≈ 700 tokens**.

| Turns a day | Injected tokens | Cache hit (0.02 / M) | Cache miss (1 / M) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 35 K | 0.0007 | 0.035 |
| 200 | 140 K | 0.0028 | 0.14 |

**Under a cent a day.** Even with no cache hit it is spare change.

ofttold-memory README · What it costs in tokens：**What actually costs money is the conversation, not this plugin.** The longer the context, the more gets re-sent each turn — the bill follows length, not the 700 tokens here.

Our own case (2026-11-03 → 11-06, four days, 1108 steps, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, list price at the time): **236 M input tokens** (202 M of them cache hits) and **818 K output** — **around 40–80 CNY**. That is "talking all day" intensity, not an average user.

ofttold-memory README · What it costs in tokens：Formula (prices change; plug in your own): **per turn ≈ context tokens × input price + output tokens × output price**, with the plugin's ~700 tokens counted inside the context.

To see your own bill: the session log stores `inputTokens` / `cacheReadTokens` / `outputTokens` per call — add them up.

---

ofttold-memory README · Quick start：**That is the whole setup.** It installs the prebuilt package from npm — no build step,
so no build approval is needed. To track the repository instead, use
`github:IcyDate/ofttold-memory` in place of the package name. The first run creates `.ofttold/` **inside the current workspace**, with a
five-file skeleton: `memory.md` (the injected source), `index.md` (the diary index),
`relationship.md` (who the assistant is, plus the live emotion value), `detours.md`
(the shapes of mistakes it keeps making), and `diary/` (one file per day). **All of it is empty shells and comments — not one memory is
pre-filled**, because what to remember is the one thing nobody can decide for you. Point `memoryDir` at a folder you already use — a diary, an index, a rules file — and it
**fills in only the files that are missing, never rewriting one that exists**. That
typically means adding `relationship.md` (where the emotion vocabulary and cache live)
and `diary/` (which the end-of-block nudge depends on); without them the writing half
of the scheme is absent.

ofttold-memory README · Quick start：Then open **Settings → 拾光 / Oft-told** to adjust it with a mouse, or edit the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml` by hand.

---
ofttold-memory README · What goes in the file：```markdown

ofttold-memory README · Oft-told：> Cap of 8 suggested. When it is full, one entry is evicted — and the eviction
> itself is the ranking, which beats "add one whenever it comes to mind".

- **Where the project is** → `~/work/my-project` | saves asking every time
- **What not to touch** → do not edit `config/prod.yml`
ofttold-memory README · Who I am：- (how you address me, speech habits, temper, what I care about)

ofttold-memory README · Hard rules：- (things whose absence causes wrong work: who owns what, commands never to run)
```

**One test for what belongs:** would getting this wrong without seeing it cause a
mistake? Not "important", not "mentioned often" — *"not seeing this would break
the work"*. Written to that test, eight entries are plenty; written to "important",
nothing is ever enough.

ofttold-memory README · A full list does not keep growing：Past eight lines the plugin **ranks which one sinks** rather than asking anyone to delete
one: what gets reached for stays, what has gone quiet drops out of view. Sinking is **not
deleting** — the line is still in the file, and one mention in a diary day floats it back.

The formula and its reasoning are in **[Design notes § the sinking mechanism](docs/design.en.md)**.
section: A full list does not keep growing

text:
ofttold-memory README · The day opens with a paragraph：A day's file starts with `## 今天（17:40 更新）` — two or three sentences saying what the day
was and what it was like, grumbling included. Detail lives below it, for whoever wants it.
section: The day opens with a paragraph

text:
ofttold-memory README · The day opens with a paragraph：It is **rewritten as the day is written**, not filled in at night. The plugin compares the
`（HH:mm 更新）` stamp with the last `## HH:mm` heading, so a body that keeps growing after
its summary is named instead of quietly going stale. `summaryFrom` (default `17:30`) holds
the requirement back until the day is actually far enough along to summarise.
section: The day opens with a paragraph

text:
ofttold-memory README · The diary check：| What it sees | What it says |
|---|---|
| More than `diarySections` sections (**off by default**) | `9 sections, over the 8-per-day bar` |
| A section with no `情绪：` line | `2 without an \`情绪：\` line` |
| A tag whose word is not in the vocabulary | `烦躁 not in the vocabulary` |
| Tags but no vocabulary section at all | `tags used, but relationship.md has no \`情绪词表\` section` |
| No summary after `summaryFrom` | `no \`## 今天\` summary at the top` |
| A summary that lags the body | `summary stopped at 17:40, body runs to 21:10` |

ofttold-memory README · The diary check：**"A tag must come from the vocabulary" is structural, not taste.** The live value can only
be a vocabulary word, so a tag outside it can never be matched — that day does not fail, it
just stops being reachable through the emotion path. Reading fine while being an orphan is
exactly the failure this plugin exists to remove, so the check names it.

ofttold-memory README · The diary check：**Why it never repairs anything**: consolidating means compressing, and compressing deletes
the evidence the weight counts. Reasoning in **[Design notes](docs/design.en.md)**.

ofttold-memory README · Setting an emotion：The `**现在**` line in `relationship.md` is the **live value**: the feeling right now, no
reason attached. It is written by tool, not by remembering a format:

```
remember_emotion(word: "定")
→ 现在：`定`（2026-10-30 11:20 更新）（原来是 `心虚`）
```

ofttold-memory README · Setting an emotion：- The word must be in the same file's `## 情绪词表` section, or it is **refused** with the
  list of words that exist.
- A missing vocabulary section is also refused — inventing a default list here would be one
  more copy that drifts.
- Only the backticked value and the timestamp change; the rest of the line is untouched.

ofttold-memory README · Setting an emotion：**Why a tool and not a paragraph**: this line changes several times a day, and both ways to
get it wrong are silent — a word outside the list stops matching any diary tag, and a stale
timestamp makes the cache look fresher than it is.

ofttold-memory README · The line at the end：If the folder has a `diary/`, the injected block closes with one status line:

```
- no diary entry for 2026-10-30 yet (`diary/2026-10-30.md`)
```

**Deliberately a status line, not an instruction** — no "write it now", no naming the skill.
The same tail carries the diary check above, and that check is the one with bad news; a
reminder that also sounds like a nag makes both lines skippable. It costs a single `stat`.

ofttold-memory README · The line at the end：`diaryCadence` decides how often it may appear: `daily`, `weekly` (quiet while anything was
written in the last seven days) or `off`. A folder without `diary/` is silent under all
three — that is the layout answering.

ofttold-memory README · The line at the end：**There is a third state neither of those sees.** Today's file exists, this session wrote
it, and then it sat untouched for hours. Every check stays green the whole time — the file
really is there — while those hours never went in. `diaryStaleHours` (default `2`) makes the
tail name **the hour it was last written and how long it has been**:
`- today's entry was last written at 11:36, more than 2h ago`. It states the hour, never
whether to write, and it does not count minutes upward — a fact, not a clock ticking at you.
`0` turns it off.

ofttold-memory README · The line at the end：**`relationship.md` gets named once a day until it is opened.** The file never enters the
injected block — it is only there when something opens it — so the tail says
`- \`relationship.md\` has not been opened today` until the AI actually opens it with a file
tool. It measures tool reads, not shell reads, so it errs toward asking again rather than
assuming the file was seen.

ofttold-memory README · The line at the end：**A task that carries a due date is named on the day.**
`- [ ] 2026-11-02 起 ｜ 2026-11-05 到期 ｜ …` makes the tail say
`- 1 task due now: 修上游白名单（今天到期）` that morning, and `（逾期 3 天）` afterwards.
Without a due date a task only ever ages — `the oldest open 5 days` is an age, not a moment.

ofttold-memory README · The settings that matter：| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryDir` | `.ofttold` (inside the workspace) | Your memory folder. Missing files are filled in on first run; existing ones are never rewritten. |
| `sections` | see below | Which headings ride along. Unset: the `Oft-told` / `常被提起` heading (whichever comes first in the file) plus `我是谁` and `硬约定` when they exist. |
| `maxChars` | `600` | Character budget per section. 600 characters ≈ 400 tokens. |
| `anchorCap` | `8` | How many bold bullets a section keeps in view; the rest sink without being deleted. `0` turns it off. |
| `summaryFrom` | `"17:30"` | When the day's `## 今天` summary starts being expected. |
| `diaryCadence` | `"daily"` | How often the folder is expected to grow: `daily` / `weekly` (quiet while anything was written in the last 7 days) / `off`. |
| `diaryStaleHours` | `2` | After this many hours untouched, the tail names when today's entry was last written. Fact only, no prompt. `0` turns it off. |
| `diarySections` | `0` | Sections per day. Default `0` = don't count — **a count cannot tell a transcript from a record**. |
| `diaryCheck` | `true` | The diary check on

ofttold-memory README · The settings that matter：Everything else has a working default. The full field list, the object form of
`sections` for the rare per-section case, exact heading matching, and cross-platform
behaviour are in **[Configuration](docs/config.en.md)**.

---

ofttold-memory README · How it works：> The notebook is a handful of markdown files on your own machine. Once at the start of a
> session it is read and injected, and from then on it is part of the context every turn —
> **zero cost after the first turn.** 600 characters is about 400 tokens, charged once per
> session. The few settings worth changing are in [configuration](docs/config.md).

ofttold-memory README · How it works：```mermaid flowchart LR A[your notebook
memory.md] -->|by section heading| B[read + truncate] B --> C[inject once
as a user message] C --> D[session context] One read, one injection. No index, no embeddings, no database, no second pass. ---

ofttold-memory README · When nothing appears：A missing file or a renamed heading never throws. **When no section loads at all, the block
says what it tried:**

```
Could not load any section. Tried: index.md → 常被提起 (heading_not_found)
```

`heading_not_found` is exact: `常被提起` does not match `常被提起（手动维护）`. An empty
folder gets a different sentence — *this is the first day, not a fault*.

**The record is still the answer:**

```sh
cat ~/.dsh/ofttold-memory/diagnostics.json
```

ofttold-memory README · When nothing appears：Every injection decision, with the folder, how many sections loaded, which failed
and why. **It never records the text of your notes**, so it is safe to paste into
an issue. The settings page has a **Copy issue summary** button for the same
information.

ofttold-memory README · When nothing appears：| `event` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `injected` | Worked. `loaded` = sections, `chars` = block size. |
| `nothing-loaded` | Folder found, no configured heading matched — usually a renamed heading. The session gets a line naming each file and heading that was tried. |
| `tail` | The block-tail line: `nudged` means today's entry was missing, `checked` means the diary check spoke, and `issue` is what it said. |

ofttold-memory README · When nothing appears：An absent file means the plugin never reached a decision, which points at the
install rather than the content.

---

ofttold-memory README · What it touches, and what it leaves alone：For a supply-chain reviewer. This plugin reads and writes files — that cannot be
declared away — so here is exactly what:
section: What it touches, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · What it touches, and what it leaves alone：| | |
|---|---|
| **Reads** | the `##` sections you name, inside `memoryDir`; today's entry under `diary/`; the vocabulary in `relationship.md`; the size of `detours.md` |
| **Writes** | only inside `memoryDir`: filling in missing skeleton files, stamping a start date onto an undated line, appending or ticking a task in `memory.md`, rewriting the one `**now**` line in `relationship.md`, renaming a legacy file into its new name |
| **Never writes** | anything outside `memoryDir`. Not `~/.dsh`, not the workspace, not session data |
| **Network** | none. No outbound request of any kind |
| **Subprocess** | none. No exec, no spawn, no shell |
| **Credentials** | none. No environment secrets, no keychain |
section: What it touches, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · What it touches, and what it leaves alone：**Runtime dependencies: zero.** There is no `dependencies` block — every `@deepseek-ai/*`
package is a `peerDependency` provided by the host, and so is `schemastery`.

**Failure bounds:** no read or write failure is ever thrown into the host. The injected block
says in one line what it tried and why nothing was read; a missing folder gets the skeleton
filled in; an unwritable path goes quiet instead of retrying.

section: What it touches, and what it leaves alone

text:
ofttold-memory README · Where the name comes from：This plugin was extracted from a working arrangement between one person and one
agent, and it kept the name they gave it.

**拾光** (*shí guāng*) — to pick up the light, and a homophone of 时光, *time*. The
idea sits in **拾**: to gather back up, one piece at a time, what has scattered.

ofttold-memory README · Where the name comes from：The arrangement was a folder of diaries, an index holding a short list of things
that keep coming back, and one instruction at the top of the agent's notes: *read
these two files before every session.* The instruction held until it did not — and
it failed exactly where it was meant to hold, at the start of a session, when the
new message is the only thing that matters.

ofttold-memory README · Where the name comes from：So the instruction became a mechanism. That is the whole change: **the list moved
out of something the model had to remember into context it cannot miss.**

---

ofttold-memory README · Why not just put it in `AGENTS.md`?：Because an instruction and an injected message are not paid for the same way.

| | Present every turn | Paid per turn | Can it be skipped |
|---|---|---|---|
| A rule in `AGENTS.md` | yes | the rule's full length | yes — silently |
| This plugin | yes | about 700 tokens, mostly cache hits | no — it is part of that turn's conversation |
section: Why not just put it in `AGENTS.md`?

text:
ofttold-memory README · Why not just put it in `AGENTS.md`?：**Both ride along with every request, and both go through the cache.** Two things
differ: **length**, and whether it gets skipped as background. A measured injection
is about **945 characters ≈ 700 tokens** with eight lines, and a rule is often
longer than that. The rule loses as soon as the rule is longer than the injected
block.

**Put the content in a memory file, not the instruction in `AGENTS.md`.**
